decls.name: TaskPhase
decls.doc: What the engine says about one step's task.

decls.name: CloseoutAsked
decls.doc: What the engine's record of a task says of its closeout: `false`, never asked for one — a task from before closeouts; `true`, asked; `unsigned`, asked, and its last attempt ended without it — the a…

decls.name: Run
decls.doc: A run record: a git run (`GitRun`), whose steps work on branches of one repository, or a folder run (`FolderRun`), whose steps work in folders the run makes and which needs no repository.

decls.name: FolderRun
decls.doc: A run of a team whose every step says `workspace: folder`: no repository, no base, no branch, no worktrees.

decls.name: PlaceKind
decls.doc: The kinds of workspace a run's steps work in: `git`, which a record without `place` is, and `folder`.

decls.name: placeOf
decls.doc: Which kind of workspace a run's steps work in.

decls.name: isGitRun
decls.doc: Whether a run is a git run: what reading its repository, base and branches needs.

decls.name: Approval
decls.doc: A person's word at a gate, as its file says it (`wf approve`): the step, the try it approves, when, and what they said with it — the words every step after the gate is handed under `## Approved` (`…

decls.name: Acceptance
decls.doc: A person's word at a loop out of rounds, as its file says it (`wf accept`): the looping step, the try it accepts, when, and what they said — the words every step after the loop is handed under `## …

decls.name: StepStatus
decls.doc: Where one step stands.

decls.name: satisfiesAfter
decls.doc: What a follower may be filed on.

decls.name: stopsFollowers
decls.doc: Final without satisfying `after`: nothing waiting on a step in one of these can ever run.

decls.name: assess
decls.doc: What should happen to this run now.

decls.name: hasGate
decls.doc: Whether a step's closeout waits for a person before anything after it is filed: its own `gate: true`, or a gate the run was started with.

decls.name: gatesOf
decls.doc: The steps a run is gated at, in the order they run: those its workflow gates, and those it was started with.

decls.name: approvalOf
decls.doc: The approval of the try a step is on, if a person gave one (`wf approve`).

decls.name: spentApprovals
decls.doc: The approvals a later try of their step has spent: each names a try the step is past.

decls.name: acceptanceOf
decls.doc: What a person accepted of a loop on the try its looping step is on (`wf accept`).

decls.name: spentAcceptances
decls.doc: The acceptances a later try of their looping step has spent: each names a try the step is past.

decls.name: askedAgain
decls.doc: Whether a looping step's closeout asks for another round of its loop — `again: true` — with nobody having accepted the work as it stands.

decls.name: gateWords
decls.doc: Where a step that may be sent back stands at its gate, in words: `is awaiting approval`, or `is approved (try 1, at …), and nothing after it is filed yet`.

decls.name: approvalWordsRefusal
decls.doc: Why the words given with an approval cannot ride on it — or null.

decls.name: approvalRefusal
decls.doc: Why `wf approve` will not approve this step, in words that name the fix — or null, when it may: the step waits at its gate.

decls.name: atGate
decls.doc: Whether a step waits at its gate: gated (`hasGate`), signed off on its own work — verified, or unverified with no check — and not approved for the try it is on (`approvalOf`).

decls.name: approvedFirst
decls.doc: Whether a step's gate holds it BEFORE it is filed rather than after it signs off: it is gated (`hasGate`) and works in the repository's own checkout (`workspace: main`).

decls.name: waitsAtGate
decls.doc: Whether the run waits at that step's gate now, with nothing of the step filed: it is approved first (`approvedFirst`), it has not been filed, nobody has approved the try it would be filed on, and e…

decls.name: notHandedOn
decls.doc: The steps an ending step waits on that have not handed their work on, in the workflow's order: one that has not satisfied `after`, and a looping step that asked for another round (`roundWanted`), w…

decls.name: unheld
decls.doc: The ending steps a pass is about to un-hold: those held at their gate, unfiled (`waitsAtGate`), that wait on a step this pass files again — a try due, or a step a round re-files (`roundSpans`).

decls.name: endingStopped

decls.name: sentBack

decls.name: sendBackTo
decls.doc: The steps a send-back at a gate goes to: the gated step itself, once it has run — or, at a gate held before its step is filed, the steps it waits on, whose work the objection is about.

decls.name: CheckoutHold
decls.doc: Which run's `workspace: main` step is working in a repository's own checkout while another run's waits for it (`heldCheckouts`): the run, and its step.

decls.name: MainClaim
decls.doc: A run's claim on a repository's own checkout on a pass (`checkoutHold` in runner.ts): the `workspace: main` step that works there, the repository, and either `holds` — its task is filed and the eng…

decls.name: heldCheckouts
decls.doc: The runs whose ending step waits for a checkout another run's step has, each with the run and step holding it.

decls.name: heldByCheckout
decls.doc: Whether the checkout holds this step back on a pass: it works in the repository's own checkout (`workspace: main`), and another run's step is in that one directory (`heldCheckouts`).

decls.name: endingAsked

decls.name: checkoutWord
decls.doc: A run whose ending step waits for the repository's own checkout, as `wf ls` says it on that step's line: `waiting on the checkout (r-1's ship has it)`.

decls.name: checkoutLine
decls.doc: What `wf decide` says for an ending step still waiting for the repository's own checkout: which run's step is in it, and what frees this one.

decls.name: BranchStanding
decls.doc: Where a run's result branch stands against the base branch it was cut from, as git says it on a pass (`branchStandings` in runner.ts): `on` it — merged, or with nothing committed past the run's bas…

decls.name: branchWord
decls.doc: One branch's standing, for a person: `wf/r-1/implement is on main`, `… is ahead of main by 3 commits`, `… is gone: git no longer has it`.

decls.name: resultOnBase
decls.doc: Whether git has already taken a run's result: every result branch is on the base branch (`branchStandings`), so an ending step that merges has nothing left to merge — a person merged it by hand, as…

decls.name: onBaseNote
decls.doc: An ending at its gate whose work git already has on the base branch, beside its line on `wf ls` where the approval would be: where each branch stands, that nothing is left for the step to merge and…

decls.name: toDecide
decls.doc: What a person has to decide about a run's result — the fifth reason a run waits on one, beside a step blocked, unsigned, over budget or at a gate.

decls.name: merges
decls.doc: Whether the workflow has a step that acts on the base branch itself (`workspace: main`): the folder says what happens when the work is done, so nobody is handed its branch and told to type `git mer…

decls.name: endingSteps
decls.doc: The workflow's ending steps: the steps nothing waits on that have a gate (`hasGate`).

decls.name: ToDecide
decls.doc: What a run waits on a person to decide (`toDecide`): its ending step, which approving runs or accepts — or its result branches, which git ships.

decls.name: firstLine
decls.doc: The first line of a step's prose, trimmed: what a folder says its ending step would do, on `wf ls` and `wf decide`.

decls.name: toDecideWords
decls.doc: What `wf ls` says after `→ to decide:`, and the board's banner: what is to be decided, and the command that decides it.

decls.name: gateRefusal
decls.doc: Why a run cannot be gated at these steps, in words that name the fix — or null.

decls.name: hasStarted
decls.doc: Whether any step of the run has been filed, on any try — a step a round moved behind still has its tries.

decls.name: gated
decls.doc: Whether the gate applies to this run, and a parent is read at all: it waits on runs, nobody has called it off, and nothing of it has been filed.

decls.name: waitingOn
decls.doc: The runs in `after` that have not shipped, in the order they were given.

decls.name: runReady
decls.doc: Whether the tick may file this run's roots: true when every run in its `after` has shipped, as `wf decide` says it of that run — not running, not cancelled, and every result branch on the base bran…

decls.name: RunSlot

decls.name: runCapOf
decls.doc: `WF_MAX_RUNS` as a cap: a whole count, 0 — or unset, or empty — for none, today's behaviour.

decls.name: slotNeed
decls.doc: What a run asks of the cap on a pass.

decls.name: takesNoSlot
decls.doc: Whether a run of these steps is outside the cap on runs in flight: its workflow says `slot: none`, which `validate` allows only on a workflow of one step.

decls.name: runAdmitted
decls.doc: Whether the tick may file the roots of this run on this pass: fewer runs in flight than the cap, or no cap.

decls.name: slotFree
decls.doc: Whether a run slot is free: fewer runs in flight than the cap, or no cap.

decls.name: admissionOrder
decls.doc: Runs in the order a pass admits them: oldest by `createdAt`, then by id.

decls.name: heldRuns
decls.doc: The runs the cap holds, each with the count it was held at, as a pass would judge them from the store as it stands (`slotNeed`): every run in flight counted, then each that wants a slot admitted ol…

decls.name: slotWord
decls.doc: A run the cap holds, as `wf ls` says it on its roots: `waiting for a run slot (2 of 2 in flight)`.

decls.name: ceilingLines
decls.doc: The daemon's two ceilings, as `wf up` says them when it starts: sessions at work per pool (`WF_MAX_CONCURRENT`; `claude` with `claude-detached`, `codex` and checks each a pool, a blocked session ho…

decls.name: ParentRun
decls.doc: A run another waits on, as the tick reads it on the pass that asks (`parentOf` in runner.ts): its record, when the store has one; whether it shipped, as its own `wf decide` would say; and the resul…

decls.name: Wait
decls.doc: A run this one waits on, as `wf ls` and `wf decide` name it: its id and, when it may never ship without a person, why — the store has no such run, it was cancelled, or a result branch it recorded i…

decls.name: waitsOf
decls.doc: Each run this one waits on that has not shipped (`waitingOn`), and why it may never.

decls.name: neverShips
decls.doc: Whether a person has to act for this run to ship: nothing the tick can read will change on its own.

decls.name: waitWord
decls.doc: A run's roots, waiting, as `wf ls` says it in the status column: `waiting on a-1x2y (cancelled), b-3z4w`.

decls.name: waitAdvice
decls.doc: What a run waiting on runs leaves a person to do, in one line, for `wf decide` and for `wf ls`'s `→ waiting on you`.

decls.name: afterRefusal
decls.doc: Why `wf start --after` will not start this run, in words that name the fix — or null.

decls.name: resultSteps
decls.doc: The steps whose branch is the run's result: the steps nothing waits on (`terminalSteps`) — and, where one of those works in the repository's own checkout (`workspace: main`), the steps it waits on …

decls.name: workChecks
decls.doc: The checks the run's work was judged by: each distinct `check:` of a step that is not an ending, in the order the steps run.

decls.name: tipBranches
decls.doc: The branches whose tips this pass records (`tipsSeen`): a finished run's result branches — succeeded or failed, so neither running nor cancelled — when it cut worktrees and did not work on its base…

decls.name: tipsSeen
decls.doc: The run's `tips` once this pass has seen its branches — `seen` is each branch git has, and the commit it is at — or undefined when nothing changed, so an unchanged run is not written.

decls.name: stepStatus
decls.doc: Where one step stands — see `StepStatus`.

decls.name: standing
decls.doc: Where a step stands (`stepStatus`), and where it would stand but for being over its budget or waiting at its gate (`own`): a try's ways are its own status's.

decls.name: triedFrom
decls.doc: How a step's last try ended, as a try's brief says it (`RetryBriefing.status`): on its own work (`ownStatus`) — and, for a gated step that signed off, `awaiting approval`, since a try of it is a se…

decls.name: TRIED_FROM
decls.doc: The statuses a try takes a step on from (`retryable`): a step over its budget in one waits for a person to raise the cap.

decls.name: held
decls.doc: Whether a step reads `over budget`: over it (`overBudget`) with another session of it the way on — a try, from a status a try is taken from (a step signed off blocked, once its session has settled;…

decls.name: roundWanted
decls.doc: Whether a looping step asked for a round its `rounds:` still allows — signed, and `again: true` — which the run files on its word.

decls.name: ownStatus
decls.doc: Where a step stands on its own work, its budget aside: `stepStatus`, but never `over budget` — `budget exhausted` is the harness's end of the session, and its own.

decls.name: Spend
decls.doc: What sessions cost, as the engine measured them: the dollars of the attempts that ended with a cost on them, how many did (`measured`), and how many ended with none (`unmeasured`) — killed before i…

decls.name: TaskSpend
decls.doc: What one task's sessions cost (`Spend`), and whether its harness ended its last attempt at its budget — the engine's reason `budget`.

decls.name: SpendOf
decls.doc: What a task's sessions cost, off the engine's view of it (`taskSpend`); undefined for a task nobody read.

decls.name: taskSpend
decls.doc: What one task cost, off the engine's view of it.

decls.name: addSpend
decls.doc: Several spends as one.

decls.name: sessionTasks
decls.doc: The tasks a step's sessions ran as, every try's, each once: the try after a recheck has its session's task again (`EarlierTry`).

decls.name: stepSpend
decls.doc: What a step's tries have cost together: every try's session, once (`sessionTasks`).

decls.name: runSpend
decls.doc: What a run has cost: every step's tries.

decls.name: budgetOf
decls.doc: The cap in force on a step: the last a person raised it to (`EarlierTry.budget`: `wf retry --budget`, `wf round --budget`), else its `budget:`.

decls.name: overBudget
decls.doc: A step whose tries have together cost the cap in force on it or more — nothing left to spend, since any session spends something: what they cost, and the cap.

decls.name: loopOver
decls.doc: The steps of a looping step's loop (`loopSpan`) that are over budget, in its order: what holds its next round.

decls.name: spentWord
decls.doc: What sessions cost, for a person: `$4.20` — and `≥$4.20` when a session that ended has no cost on it, so a part never reads as the whole.

decls.name: budgetUsdFor

decls.name: MOMENTUM

decls.name: priorityOf

decls.name: Raise

decls.name: aboveWord
decls.doc: What a raise has to pass, for a person: what the step's tries cost, `$4.20`, or the cap its session was ended at, as its author wrote it, `$3`.

decls.name: raiseWords
decls.doc: A step over its budget, or ended at it, in words: `is over budget: its tries have cost $4.20 of its $3 budget`.

decls.name: budgetRefusal
decls.doc: Why a `--budget` cannot ride on this ask, in words that say what to do instead — or null.

decls.name: checkTaskId
decls.doc: The id of a step's check task.

decls.name: stepTaskId
decls.doc: The id of a step's own task on its n-th try: `<run>-<step>`, then `<run>-<step>-try<n>`.

decls.name: namesInOrder
decls.doc: The names on a run's record in the order its steps run — `steps` as `stepsOf` gives them (`orderSteps`) — then any the record has that the workflow does not, in the record's order.

decls.name: handOffDue
decls.doc: The steps whose leftovers the run commits on this pass.

decls.name: downstreamOf
decls.doc: Every step that waits on `name`, directly or through another.

decls.name: RetryMode
decls.doc: How a person asks for another try of a step, with `wf retry`.

decls.name: EarlierTry
decls.doc: A try that is over, kept on the step's record behind the one that replaced it.

decls.name: StepRecord
decls.doc: One step on the run's record: its current try's task and check, where it works, and the tries before (`Run.steps`).

decls.name: RetryAsk

decls.name: RetryHow
decls.doc: How a person asks for a try with `wf retry`: one way, the model a `--model` names, what they said with it — and `budget`, the cap `--budget` raises a step over its budget, or ended at it, to.

decls.name: Retry
decls.doc: A try to file on this pass: of which step, its number, how, on whose word — `retries:`, a person's `ask`, or `signoff`, the run's one nudge a round to a session that ended without its closeout — an…

decls.name: messageRefusal
decls.doc: Why a message cannot ride on this ask, in words that say what to do instead — or null.

decls.name: tryOf
decls.doc: The try a step is on: the first, and one more for each try its record keeps behind it.

decls.name: retriesSpent
decls.doc: The tries `retries:` has filed for a step in the round it is on.

decls.name: signoffsSpent
decls.doc: The sign-off nudges the run has filed for a step in the round it is on: at most one (`retriesDue`).

decls.name: modeWord
decls.doc: How a try was asked for, as a person typed it: `--nudge`, `--fresh`, `--model <m>`, `--recheck`.

decls.name: refusedCheck
decls.doc: Whether a check that did not pass REFUSED the work, rather than not finishing.

decls.name: retryable
decls.doc: What a person may ask for a step, and the status that says why.

decls.name: carries
decls.doc: Whether a person's ask carries what a try of its step needs past its budget (`Raise`): a `--budget` above it, on an ask that files a session.

decls.name: heard
decls.doc: Whether a person's ask says what a send-back from a gate needs (`sendsBack`): words.

decls.name: retriesDue
decls.doc: The tries due now. Pure, and blind to cancellation on purpose: `assess` answers for a cancelled run, and `advance` looks for a try a pass filed and never wrote down whatever became of the run after.

decls.name: STOPPED_FIRST
decls.doc: The ways a person's try of a step whose task has not settled may be asked for: those `retryable` takes for a session its harness blocked.
